name: Colorado River (Professor Valley / Moab Daily)
blurb: Upper Colorado along Utah Highway 128: flatwater from Cisco and Dewey Bridge, then the Class I-III Moab Daily (Fisher Towers section).

sections.notes: Flatwater. Miles (16.0) are NHD High Resolution centreline-routed between the agency points; no agency mileage found.

putInAccess.operator: Bureau of Land Management (Moab Field Office)
putInAccess.sourceName: BLM Moab FO Cisco Takeout page, 'Geographic Coordinates 38.970407, -109.2506984' (the BLM GIS point OBJECTID 67918 at 38.970099, -109.252391 sits ~150 m west on the access road loop, so the page coordinate, which imagery puts at the head of the concrete ramp, is used)
putInAccess.note: BLM Moab FO Cisco Takeout page, 'Geographic Coordinates 38.970407, -109.2506984' (the BLM GIS point OBJECTID 67918 at 38.970099, -109.252391 sits ~150 m west on the access road loop, so the page coordinate, which imagery puts at the head of the concrete ramp, is used) is the managing agency's own point. Legal boating access: BLM Moab FO: Cisco Takeout (https://www.blm.gov/visit/cisco-takeout): 'Terminus for Westwater boat trip'; Geographic Coordinates 38.970407, -109.2506984; BLM boat ramp feature. Imagery: Esri World Imagery z19 checked 2026-10-25 (research/raw/imagery/cisco_takeout.png): the BLM page coordinate is at the head of the concrete ramp, about 30-35 m from the water. The older BLM GIS point (OBJECTID 67918) was about 150 m west on the access loop and was not used (research/raw/imagery/cisco_takeout_gis_point_old.png). NHD flowline 111 m away.
putInAccess.bankSourceName: USGS NHD High Resolution flowline (flow-direction digitized) + Esri World Imagery
putInAccess.bankNote: Facing downstream (flow bearing ~197), the point is right of the NHD centreline (111 m).

sections.notes: BLM Moab Daily (Fisher Towers section): 13 miles, rapids Class I to Class III depending on season and water level. NPS Canyonlands: 'Permits are not required for overnight use or launches on BLM land along the Colorado River.'
